zh_CN: 热汤刚出锅。旧居的门在西北边；沿街向东南走就是码头。先认认路吧。【第二周交互样例，非正式剧情】
en: The soup is hot. The home gate is northwest; the dock lies southeast. Get your bearings first. [Week 2 interaction sample - not final story.]

zh_CN: 这会儿不渡河。货箱挡路就绕开些；往西边的路牌走能回县城。【第二周交互样例，非正式剧情】
en: No crossing just now. Walk around the cargo; the sign to the west leads back to town. [Week 2 interaction sample - not final story.]

zh_CN: 告示上写着：码头货物请按序搬运，勿堵街道。纸角压着一枚旧铜钱。【第二周阅读样例；尚未接入名册或证据系统】
en: The notice asks carriers to keep the street clear. An old coin weighs down one corner. [Week 2 reading sample; no roster or evidence system yet.]

zh_CN: 便笺上只有几字：出门记得关门，热饭留在灶边。纸上的折痕已被来回抚平。【第二周阅读样例，非正式剧情】
en: A short note: Shut the door when you leave. Warm food is by the stove. Its creases have been smoothed many times. [Week 2 reading sample - not final story.]
